description: Fix critical compile error in settings_screen.dart (firebase_auth import) and implement notification tap navigation, fix stale midnight streams, and improve reports month-view
steps: Fix lib/screens/settings/settings_screen.dart: Remove the `import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';` line. Replace the `on FirebaseAuthException catch (e)` block with a generic `catch (e)` that checks if the error message contains 'requires-recent-login' or similar. The deleteAccount method in AuthService already throws a plain Exception, so catch Exception instead.

Fix lib/providers/health_provider.dart: Add a midnight refresh mechanism. Add a Timer field that calculates duration until next midnight, then calls clearSubscriptions() and _subscribeToStreams(_uid!) to refresh all date-bound streams. Cancel the timer in dispose() and clearSubscriptions().

Fix lib/services/notification_service.dart: Implement _onNotificationTapped to parse the payload string and navigate to the appropriate screen. Since NotificationService is a singleton without BuildContext, add a static GlobalKey<NavigatorState> navigatorKey that main.dart assigns to the MaterialApp. Then _onNotificationTapped uses navigatorKey.currentState?.pushNamed or push routes based on payload values: 'pushup_screen' -> PushupScreen, 'fine_screen' -> FinesScreen, etc.
Update lib/main.dart to pass the navigatorKey to MaterialApp's navigatorKey parameter and to NotificationService.

Fix lib/screens/reports/reports_screen.dart: In month view, show all 30 days of data in the chart by computing weekly averages (4-5 bars for Mon-Sun of each week) instead of just showing the last 7 days. Use _dayLabels with week numbers as labels.
acceptance_criteria: settings_screen.dart has no firebase_auth import and deleteAccount error handling uses Supabase-compatible exceptions
health_provider.dart has a Timer that refreshes streams at midnight
notification_service.dart navigates to appropriate screens on notification tap
main.dart provides navigatorKey to both MaterialApp and NotificationService
reports_screen.dart month view shows meaningful 30-day visualization (weekly averages)
No references to firebase_auth remain in any Dart file
verification: Read settings_screen.dart and confirm no firebase import and proper exception handling
Read health_provider.dart and confirm midnight timer logic exists
Read notification_service.dart and confirm navigation logic on tap
Read reports_screen.dart and confirm month view shows weekly aggregation
findings: All 4 bugs fixed successfully. No Flutter SDK available so verification is static code review only. Confirmed: (1) no firebase_auth references remain in lib/, (2) health_provider now saves uid before clearSubscriptions to avoid null-dereference, (3) notification_service uses GlobalKey<NavigatorState> pattern for context-free navigation, (4) reports month view groups 30 days into 4 weekly averages. The _weeklyAverages helper handles the last week having 9 days (days 21-29) gracefully.
